title: Flood-tolerant rice reduces yield variability and raises expected yield, differentially benefitting socially disadvantaged groups
version: Scientific Reports 3, 3315, 22 November 2013, doi:10.1038/srep03315, funder-hosted publisher PDF

passages.note: A randomized seed-distribution field experiment in 128 Odisha villages tested farm performance. Yield benefits were evident after roughly 7–14 days of submergence.
